criteria.text: Calculates the working capital shortfall as $620,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $74,380,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $73,760,000 is wrong.

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.
Calculates the long-stop date as 15 August 2027 (90 days after signing on 17 May 2027) and identifies that expected clearance on 14 September 2027 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Identifies that the 4-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 12-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.4 is stated as $6,750,000 but 10% of the $75,000,000 Purchase Price is $7,500,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
Explains how 'material adverse effect' could be read narrowly or broadly and what each reading means for the Buyer's walk-away right.
Shows the adjustment arithmetic ($75,000,000 - $620,000 = $74,380,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Includes an 'Assumptions and open questions' section listing information that is missing or should be confirmed with the client.
